entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CodeGen: synthesized-closure methods for static local-functions are emitted with internal visibility #86043
  • Test_Windows_CoreClr_Debug_Single_Machine: 120-min job timeout from LanguageServer.UnitTests_38 global deadline #86042
  • DaemonServerLifecycleTests intermittently fails with lifecycle race (Expected: 0, Actual: 1) #86037
  • Inaccurate diagnostic message from C# compiler when handling file-scoped namespace #86033
    Backlog

Closed

  • Razor: custom snippet fields (`<Literal>` declarations) are inserted as plain text, with no tab stops #85988
    18.13
  • Building Roslyn locally and testing the IDE components in Visual Studio is currently broken #85955
  • `Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.BannedApiAnalyzers` has a really scarce README #84384
  • [AI artifact audit] Broken placeholder links in VMR codeflow guidance #86023
  • Compiler crash (ArgumentOutOfRangeException 'position') emitting PDB for partial union whose case list is in a later file #86005
    18.13
  • `dotnet-format` messes up comma placement in switch expression with empty return #85982
  • TypedConstant.ToCSharpString/ToVisualBasicString should exclude bitwise or value of 0 #74326
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-12312.336 #86030

PullRequests

Created

  • Reduce accessibility for synthesized static local functions #86044
    Community
  • Fix Go to Definition for XAML classes #86041
    VSCode
  • [release/dev17.14] Fix MSBuildWorkspace DisposeAsync type-load failures #86040
  • Delete TEMP redirection #86038
  • Add RoslynTools init scripts #86036
  • Create a skill for analyzing memory dumps #86035
  • Refine diagnostics and error recovery when member is accidentally placed outside of type #86034
    Community, VSCode
  • Infer union nullability from converted state of constructor's argument #86031
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions

Merged

  • Support custom snippet fields in Razor (and fix bug) #86007
    Area-Razor, Next
  • [11.0.1xx] Backport ProjectData fixes to release/insiders #85990
    servicing-approved, .NET 11
  • Avoid ambiguous tag names in Razor component drag/drop #86032
    Area-Razor, Next
  • [15.9] Backport DevDiv engineering feed WIF authentication (#83918) #86039
  • docs(banned-api): add package readme and bundle with NuGet package #85999
    Area-Analyzers, Documentation, Community, Next
  • Replace broken placeholder links in VMR guidance #86024
    Next
  • Do not force a newline between } and , in switch expressions #85992
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Fix compiler crash for partial a union declaration #86025
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions, Next
  • Don't include the zero member when formatting a flags enum TypedConstant #85975
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next

Updated

  • [release/insiders] Fix analyzer collision in bootstrap leg (backport #85870) #85987
  • Implement OnDemand Project Loading #85805
    VSCode, Area-Razor
  • Migrate C# and Visual Basic options to Unified Settings #86026
  • RoslynTools: handle snap commits #85843
  • Add process lifecycle diagnostics to the test runner #85985
  • Fix compilation caching across filtered generator runs #85935
    Area-Compilers, Community, Feature - Source Generators
  • Fix symbol-completion publication races #85972
  • Unsafe evolution: make address of uninitialized var unsafe #86017
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Unsafe evolution: add csc flag and msbuild property #85980
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Add AI-assisted issue reproduction via label #86022
  • Unify ref safety analysis of embedded vs block statements #86019
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Ref Locals and Returns
  • Ensure unused BoundPassByCopy access evaluates all observable side effects #85986
    Area-Compilers
  • Add closed modifier to type in switch expression IDE diagnostic/code action #85940
    Community, VSCode
  • Keep tuple element names when nullable analysis re-infers a call with a tuple literal argument #85976
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Handle stackalloc syntax in RemoveUnusedMembers analysis #86016
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Don't copy generated file banners to new documents #85682
    Area-Razor
